title: Not worth the money.
text: Not worth the money.. [[VIDEOID:e7b388138bb200ae9f310cf74a0f855f]] Silverware portion of this rack is HORRIBLE - doesn’t fit right & it is too big for the space it is to slide into & the hook is plastic & near impossible to open up. Already has stress marks on the unit.

product_metadata.title: GSlife Dish Drying Rack, Small Dish Drainers Rack with Utensil Holder Polished Anti Rust for Kitchen Counter, White
features: Compact Dish Rack for Small Space - Dish strainer of 16.45"(L) X 12.05"(W) X 4.3"(H), the dishes drying rack is perfect for a small family, ideal for small kitchens
Rustproof Material - The small dish rack with coating technology, durable and long-lasting can effectively prevent rust issues, perfect for your kitchen
Detachable Utensil Holder - This utensil holder with holes has 2 compartment, good for organizing spoons and knives. Easy to remove and clean, which helps to keep utensils neat and organized
Non-slip Rubber Feet - Equipped with 4 anti-scratch footpads, easy to assemble which can effectively prevent slipping and protect the countertop from scratches
Removable Drain with Tray - This dish rack without a drain spout can collect excess water and prevents the countertop from getting wet, keeping your sink and kitchen neat
